svg.title: Shoga-Speaks
svg.desc: Shoga, a cheerful green parrot, speaks three speech bubbles, one each for a developer, a QA tester and a product owner. The same three messages are said in Roman-Urdu, then Dutch, then English. Shoga-Speaks makes Claude Code explain things in your language and for your role.
